The rear bumper cover is cracked across its cenetr and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing running along the left

quarter panel, and a modest amount of labor for alignment of the trunk lid. The labor hours requested are consistent with the work
involved, and the invoices submitted show no duplicated or repeated charges. Parts were listed at standard rates. Recommend
